title: ScaleEnv: Scaling Environment Synthesis from Scratch for Generalist Interactive Tool-Use Agent Training
authors_zh: Dunwei Tu, Hongyan Hao, Hansi Yang, Yihao Chen, Yi-Kai Zhang, Zhikang Xia, Yu Yang, Yueqing Sun, Xingchen Liu, Furao Shen, Qi Gu, Hui Su, Xunliang Cai
paper_type_zh: 可执行环境合成、程序化验证与智能体强化学习
best_for_zh: 研究环境数据工厂、数据库状态奖励、大批量 rollout、OOD 泛化及 reset/replay 审计的读者
one_line: ScaleEnv synthesizes 16 database-backed domains and 2,560 verifiable tasks for large-batch GRPO, but the environments, rollouts, rewards, code, checkpoints, reset mechanism, and replay manifests are not verified as released.
ScaleEnv 自动合成 16 个数据库工具域与 2,560 个可验证任务，用于大批量 GRPO；但完整环境、轨迹、奖励、代码、checkpoint、reset 机制与 replay 清单尚未核实公开。
why: It links scalable environment generation to executable verification and OOD agent training while exposing the distinction between a documented recipe and a reusable, licensed, replayable environment/trajectory corpus.
inclusion_reason: ScaleEnv defines an auditable environment-data factory: executable tools and database states generate task-linked observations and actions, while procedural tests and terminal state comparison provide programmatic feedback for large-batch agentic RL.

title: Problem
问题
html:
ScaleEnv tackles the shortage of diverse, executable environments for tool-use RL. Real APIs are costly, slow, and safety-constrained; LLM simulators can hallucinate state; manually integrated sandboxes do not scale. The method therefore generates the action space, state schema, executable code, tasks, and verifier from domain names rather than adapting a fixed API collection.

The reported training universe contains 16 synthetic domains and 2,560 tasks. An environment has about 50 tools and 5–20 database tables on average; the appendix reports roughly 25 to more than 70 tools and 5 to 22 tables across domains. Per-domain task counts range from 64 to 512. Each task binds an initial database state, distractors, user profile and intent, executable seed chain, expected final state, and matching rules.

The learning object is an interactive rollout: user-simulator messages, natural-language agent responses, tool calls, tool results or errors, database mutations, and a terminal state reward. ScaleEnv documents how to synthesize these objects, but the complete environments, 2,560 tasks, rollouts, rewards, code, models, and reset/replay package were not verified as public artifacts.

ScaleEnv 面向工具使用 RL 中多样、可执行环境稀缺的问题。真实 API 成本高、速度慢并受安全限制；LLM simulator 可能虚构状态；人工集成 sandbox 又难以扩展。因此，该方法从领域名称生成动作空间、状态 schema、可执行代码、任务与 verifier，而不是改造固定 API 集合。

论文报告的训练 universe 包含 16 个合成领域与 2,560 个任务。每个环境平均约 50 个工具和 5–20 张数据库表；附录显示各领域约有 25 到超过 70 个工具、5 到 22 张表。单领域任务数从 64 到 512。每个任务绑定初始数据库状态、干扰项、用户 profile 和 intent、可执行 seed chain、预期终态与匹配规则。

学习对象是一条交互 rollout：用户 simulator 消息、智能体自然语言响应、工具调用、工具结果或错误、数据库变更，以及终局状态奖励。ScaleEnv 说明了这些对象如何合成，但完整环境、2,560 个任务、rollout、奖励、代码、模型与 reset/replay 包均未核实为公开工件。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ScaleEnv separates domain foundation from task instantiation. The foundation starts with tool and database schemas, implements database code before tool code, and validates both through generated tests. A dependency graph then records data flow, pre/post-conditions, and shared-table state dependencies among verified tools.

Task construction samples an executable seed chain, instantiates the smallest consistent database state, injects schema-valid distractors, and generates a grounded user profile and intent. Dependency-aware breadth-first expansion adds tools only when their inputs and outputs are satisfiable; an LLM-gated stage adds further chains, and every extension is executed so the state can be repaired. This makes exploration space broader than the reference path.

Feedback has two programmatic layers. Procedural tests distinguish 3 outcomes: success, anticipated rejection, and unexpected failure; the last triggers debugging. Terminal reward compares final database columns under 3 policies: exempt fields, exact hard constraints, and fuzzy semantic alignment. The Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct user simulator supplies dialogue feedback, but it does not replace the database-state verifier.

ScaleEnv 将领域基础与任务实例化分开。领域基础从工具和数据库 schema 开始，先实现数据库代码，再实现工具代码，并通过生成测试验证两者。随后，依赖图记录已验证工具间的数据流、前后置条件与共享表状态依赖。

任务构建先采样可执行 seed chain，实例化最小一致数据库状态，注入符合 schema 的干扰记录，再生成有状态依据的用户 profile 与 intent。依赖感知 BFS 只在输入输出可满足时添加工具；LLM gated 阶段继续加入 chain，而且每次扩展都会实际执行，以便修复状态。由此，探索空间宽于参考路径。

反馈包含两个程序化层次。程序测试区分 3 种结果：success、anticipated rejection 和 unexpected failure，最后一种会触发 debug。终局奖励按 3 类政策比较数据库列：exempt field、精确 hard constraint 与模糊 semantic alignment。Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 用户 simulator 提供对话反馈，但不会取代数据库状态 verifier。

title: Method
方法
html:
DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-4.7, GPT-5.1, and Qwen3-32B instantiate schema, database, code, test, debug, dependency, and task agents. ScaleEnv generates 16 foundations and 2,560 tasks. The scaling study holds 1,024 tasks fixed while varying training domains over 2, 4, 8, and 16; a separate stability check compares two non-overlapping 4-domain sets with 1,024 tasks.

The synthesis loop is executable throughout. Database tests enforce integrity constraints. Tool tests use matched instances and expected state transitions. Seed chains are code, so earlier outputs feed later arguments. State construction executes the chain, injects distractors, derives the ground-truth final state, and then broadens the dependency subgraph. Unexpected errors invoke a debug agent until the sampled test passes.

Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B are trained with Zero-RL GRPO for 48 steps. Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct simulates the user. Rollout batch sizes are 1,024 and 2,048 respectively, demonstrating large-batch collection, but the paper does not disclose group size per task, concurrency, worker count, hardware, uniform horizon, decoding, seeds, or the numerical learning rate in the rendered public text.

For replay, a task needs its initial state, tool/database code and dependencies, simulator setting, agent checkpoint, full dialogue/tool trace, final-state checker, and random seeds. The conceptual task object supports reset to an initial database, yet no reset API, isolation guarantee, snapshot format, or runnable package is released.

DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM-4.7、GPT-5.1 与 Qwen3-32B 分别承担 schema、database、code、test、debug、dependency 和 task agent。ScaleEnv 生成 16 个领域基础与 2,560 个任务。Scaling 实验固定 1,024 个任务，将训练领域数设为 2、4、8、16；另一个稳定性检查比较两个互不重叠的 4 领域集合，每组仍含 1,024 个任务。

整个合成循环保持可执行。数据库测试检查完整性约束，工具测试使用匹配实例与预期状态转移。Seed chain 表示为代码，使前序输出进入后续参数。状态构建实际运行 chain、注入干扰项、导出 ground-truth 终态，再扩展依赖子图。意外错误调用 debug agent，直到采样测试通过。

Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-32B 使用 Zero-RL GRPO 训练 48 步，Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 模拟用户。两者 rollout batch size 分别为 1,024 和 2,048，体现大批量采集；但论文未披露单任务 group size、并发度、worker 数、硬件、统一 horizon、解码、种子，且公开渲染文本未显示数值学习率。

回放一个任务需要初始状态、工具/数据库代码与依赖、simulator 设置、agent checkpoint、完整对话/工具 trace、终态 checker 和随机种子。概念上的任务对象支持恢复初始数据库，但论文没有发布 reset API、隔离保证、snapshot 格式或可运行包。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On tau2-Bench, Qwen3-SE-8B scores 50.9, 37.5, and 27.2 on Retail, Airline, and Telecom, versus 38.4, 30.5, and 21.5 for Qwen3-8B. On VitaBench, Qwen3-SE-32B scores 10.8 on Cross and 34.5 on Instore, versus 5.3 and 22.5 for Qwen3-32B. Its VitaBench Pass@4 average rises from 36.0 to 46.8.

The reward ablation averages 3 tau2-Bench domains. Rule-based verification reaches Avg@4 38.5, Pass@4 62.9, and Pass^4 15.0, versus 36.5, 58.8, and 14.6 for LLM-as-a-Judge. Removing execution verification also degrades the trained agent, supporting the claim that plausible but non-executable tasks produce conflicting learning signals.

With 1,024 tasks fixed, Pass@4 rises as domain count moves through 2, 4, 8, and 16. Two non-overlapping 4-domain subsets also outperform the base model. These experiments support diversity scaling and executable verification; they do not establish task-level decontamination, deterministic replay, exhaustive test coverage, or quality of an independently downloadable corpus.

在 tau2-Bench 上，Qwen3-SE-8B 的 Retail、Airline、Telecom 得分为 50.9、37.5、27.2，而 Qwen3-8B 为 38.4、30.5、21.5。在 VitaBench 上，Qwen3-SE-32B 的 Cross 和 Instore 得分为 10.8 与 34.5，而 Qwen3-32B 为 5.3 与 22.5；其 VitaBench Pass@4 平均值从 36.0 升至 46.8。

奖励消融对 3 个 tau2-Bench 领域取平均。规则验证器的 Avg@4、Pass@4、Pass^4 分别为 38.5、62.9、15.0，而 LLM-as-a-Judge 为 36.5、58.8、14.6。移除执行验证也会降低训练后智能体表现，支持“看似合理但不可执行的任务会产生冲突学习信号”的论点。

固定 1,024 个任务时，领域数依次扩至 2、4、8、16，Pass@4 随之上升。两个互不重叠的 4 领域子集也优于 base model。这些实验支持多样性扩展与执行验证，却不能证明任务级去污染、确定性回放、测试覆盖穷尽或独立可下载语料的质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
ScaleEnv's distinctive contribution is synthesizing the complete environment-task-reward loop from scratch. It derives a database schema from tool semantics, generates executable implementations and tests, builds a dependency graph, then instantiates stateful tasks whose verifier comes from the executed reference path rather than an LLM judgment alone.

The method treats interaction completeness as a data property: valid off-reference actions should still return meaningful observations. Graph expansion adds reachable alternatives and distractors, reducing the gap between one demonstrated chain and the broader state-action support needed for RL. This goes beyond generating static function-call pairs.

Its verification stack keeps 3 procedural outcomes and 3 terminal column policies distinct. That decomposition is reusable for future environment datasets, but programmatic verification is not a proof of full correctness. The contribution remains a recipe and scaling study until the actual environments, tests, states, and trajectories are released.

ScaleEnv 的突出贡献，是从零合成完整的环境—任务—奖励闭环。它从工具语义推导数据库 schema，生成可执行实现与测试，构建依赖图，再实例化有状态任务；任务 verifier 来自实际执行参考路径，而不只依赖 LLM 判断。

该方法把 interaction completeness 视为数据属性：偏离参考路径但有效的动作也应返回有意义观察。Graph expansion 添加可达替代路径与干扰项，缩小单条示范 chain 和 RL 所需更广状态—动作支持之间的差距。这超出了静态函数调用对生成。

验证栈明确区分 3 种程序测试结果与 3 种终局列匹配政策。这个分解可供未来环境数据集复用，但程序验证并不证明全空间正确。只有实际环境、测试、状态与轨迹公开后，这项贡献才能从配方和 scaling study 变成可复用语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• No reusable release: The 16 environments, 2,560 tasks, tests, states, rollouts, rewards, checkpoints, and framework were not verified public; only paper/source and excerpts are available.
  • Incomplete split audit: Training and the 7 benchmark evaluation domains are disjoint, but there is no generated task-level dev/test split, item mapping, template deduplication, pretraining-overlap, or memorization audit.
  • Success/failure retention: Procedural failures drive debugging and GRPO needs mixed-reward groups, yet candidate/rollout drop counts, retries, and durable successful/failed trace retention are undisclosed.
  • Reset and replay: Initial/final database states suggest resettable tasks, but no reset API, snapshot format, dependency lock, isolation test, seeds, user-simulator settings, or runtime image is released.
  • Parallelism gap: Rollout batch sizes are 1,024 and 2,048, while actual concurrency, worker scheduling, hardware, throughput, failure recovery, and cost are unknown.
  • Verifier limits: The 3 column policies can miss invalid intermediate behavior, hidden side effects, unnecessary mutations, serialization equivalence, or incorrect fuzzy matches.
  • License and privacy: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 covers the manuscript, not generated artifacts. Data is synthetic, but no PII-pattern filtering, memorization audit, provenance check, or privacy review is described.
  • Safety: The paper calls the sandbox safer than real APIs and warns of harmful-domain synthesis. It does not implement or report a malicious-domain filter, capability boundary, prompt-injection defense, or containment audit.

• 无可复用发布： 16 个环境、2,560 个任务、测试、状态、rollout、奖励、checkpoint 与框架均未核实公开；现有材料只有论文/源码与摘录。
  • 切分审计不完整： 训练域与 7 个基准评测域互斥，但没有生成任务级 dev/test 切分、item mapping、模板去重、预训练重叠或记忆审计。
  • 成功/失败保留： 程序失败驱动 debug，GRPO 也需要混合奖励组，但候选/rollout 丢弃数、重试与持久成功/失败 trace 保留均未披露。
  • Reset 与 replay： 初始/终局数据库状态暗示任务可 reset，但没有发布 reset API、snapshot 格式、依赖锁、隔离测试、种子、用户 simulator 设置或 runtime image。
  • 并行细节缺口： Rollout batch size 为 1,024 与 2,048，实际并发、worker 调度、硬件、吞吐、失败恢复和成本未知。
  • Verifier 局限： 3 类列匹配政策可能漏掉无效中间行为、隐藏副作用、不必要变更、等价序列化或错误模糊匹配。
  • 许可与隐私： CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 覆盖论文而非生成工件。数据虽为合成，但未说明 PII pattern 过滤、记忆审计、来源检查或隐私评审。
  • 安全： 论文认为 sandbox 比真实 API 更安全，也警告有害领域合成；却没有报告恶意领域 filter、能力边界、prompt injection 防御或 containment audit。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Supported uses

  • RLVR and agent training are directly evidenced: Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B are trained for 48 GRPO steps with rollout batches 1,024 and 2,048.
  • The 16-domain, 2,560-task recipe supports research on executable environment synthesis, state-grounded intents, rule-based reward, and environment-diversity scaling.
  • Procedural success, anticipated rejection, and unexpected failure can supervise environment debugging before policy rollout.

Uses requiring a release

  • Offline policy training needs complete successful and failed trajectories, user feedback, state transitions, terminal rewards, and lineage; none is verified public.
  • Environment reuse needs licensed tool/database code, tests, state snapshots, reset/isolation interfaces, dependency locks, and safety controls.
  • Reproduction needs generator prompts and model revisions, seeds, rollout grouping, decoding, simulator/checker settings, compute topology, and retained failures.

training_use therefore remains RLVR and agent training. The Card does not infer SFT, public trajectory training, or reward-model training from the paper.

有证据支持的用途

  • RLVR 与 agent training 有直接证据：Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B 训练 48 个 GRPO step，rollout batch 分别为 1,024 与 2,048。
  • 16 领域、2,560 任务配方支持研究可执行环境合成、状态 grounded intent、规则奖励与环境多样性 scaling。
  • 程序化 success、anticipated rejection、unexpected failure 可在策略 rollout 前监督环境 debug。

需要发布工件的用途

  • 离线策略训练需要完整成功/失败轨迹、用户反馈、状态转移、终局奖励与来源链；这些都未核实公开。
  • 环境复用需要许可明确的工具/数据库代码、测试、状态 snapshot、reset/isolation 接口、依赖锁和安全控制。
  • 复现需要 generator prompt 与模型修订、种子、rollout grouping、解码、simulator/checker 设置、计算拓扑及保留失败。

因此 training_use 保持为 RLVR 与 agent training。本 Card 不从论文推断 SFT、公开轨迹训练或 reward-model training。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the environment foundation and task-instantiation phases as separate lineage layers.
  • Require a task to bind initial state, intent, executable reference path, expected final state, and verifier.
  • Distinguish procedural code-test outcomes, simulator dialogue feedback, and terminal database reward.
  • Check whether off-reference valid actions have state support; a passing reference chain alone is insufficient for RL.
  • Ask for both successful and failed rollouts, plus generation/debug failures, rather than a success-only corpus.
  • Treat reset, replay, licensing, privacy, and harmful-domain prevention as release requirements, not implied properties of a virtual sandbox.

• 把 environment foundation 与 task instantiation 作为两层独立来源链阅读。
  • 要求任务绑定初始状态、intent、可执行参考路径、预期终态与 verifier。
  • 区分程序代码测试结果、simulator 对话反馈和终局数据库奖励。
  • 检查偏离参考路径的有效动作是否有状态支持；仅通过一条参考 chain 不足以服务 RL。
  • 要求同时保留成功与失败 rollout，以及生成/debug 失败，而不是只保留成功语料。
  • 将 reset、replay、许可、隐私与有害领域防护视为发布要求，而非虚拟 sandbox 的隐含属性。

value.html: A deterministic rule-based terminal reward is normalized within each GRPO rollout group. The paper does not report a dense process reward.

value_zh.html: 确定性基于规则的终态奖励在每个 GRPO rollout 组内归一化。论文未报告稠密过程奖励。

value.html: Reward is computed at the terminal interaction state after the multi-turn task. A uniform maximum turn count or explicit agent termination protocol is not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 奖励在多轮任务后的终态交互状态计算。未披露统一最大轮次数或显式智能体终止协议。

value.html: Paper, appendix examples, generation algorithm, schemas/code excerpts, statistics, and one example trajectory are public. The complete 16 environments, 2,560 tasks, tests, initial/final states, rollouts, rewards, checkpoints, generator prompts, and runnable framework were not verified as public artifacts.

value_zh.html: 论文、附录示例、生成算法、schemas/代码摘录、统计与一条示例轨迹公开。完整的 16 个环境、2,560 个任务、测试、初始/终态、rollouts、奖励、checkpoints、生成器提示与可运行框架未核验为公开产物。

value.html: Domain keyword -> multi-agent schema/code generation -> procedural test/debug loop -> dependency graph -> executable seed chain -> initial state plus distractors -> graph expansion and re-execution -> grounded intent and final-state criterion -> user-simulated rollout -> rule-based terminal reward.

value_zh.html: 领域关键词 -> 多智能体 schema/代码生成 -> 程序性测试/调试循环 -> 依赖图 -> 可执行种子链 -> 初始状态加干扰项 -> 图扩展与再执行 -> 有依据意图与终态标准 -> 用户模拟 rollout -> 基于规则的终态奖励。

value.html: DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-4.7, GPT-5.1, and Qwen3-32B instantiate synthesis-agent roles. Qwen3-235B-A22B serves as the expansion oracle, and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct is the rollout user simulator.

value_zh.html: DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM-4.7、GPT-5.1 与 Qwen3-32B 实例化合成智能体角色。Qwen3-235B-A22B 作为扩展 oracle，Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 是 rollout 用户模拟器。

value.html: Multiple schema, database, code, test, debug, dependency, and task agents construct each environment from a domain name, repeatedly executing and repairing code.

value_zh.html: 多个 schema、数据库、代码、测试、调试、依赖与任务智能体从领域名称构建每个环境，反复执行并修复代码。

value.html: Synthetic user intents grounded in executable seed chains and database states, distributed across 16 author-chosen everyday/work domains.

value_zh.html: 锚定于可执行种子链与数据库状态的合成用户意图，分布在 16 个作者选定的日常/工作领域。

value.html: 2,560 tasks over 16 domains. Environment-scaling experiments hold 1,024 tasks fixed while varying domain count over 2, 4, 8, and 16. Two non-overlapping 4-domain sets with 1,024 tasks test domain stability.

value_zh.html: 16 个领域上 2,560 个任务。环境扩展实验固定 1,024 个任务，同时将领域数在 2、4、8 与 16 间变化。两个不重叠的、带 1,024 个任务的 4 领域集合测试领域稳定性。

value.html: Database integrity tests must pass. Tool tests accept correct execution/state transition and anticipated schema rejection; unexpected runtime/state failures trigger iterative debugging. Seed chains are executed, dependency-expanded tools are re-executed, and states are patched until solvable.

value_zh.html: 数据库完整性测试必须通过。工具测试接受正确执行/状态转换与预期 schema 拒绝；意外运行时/状态失败触发迭代调试。执行种子链，再执行依赖扩展的工具，并修补状态直至可解。

value.html: Uniform episode horizon and per-task rollout-group size are not disclosed. Rollout batch size is 1,024 for Qwen3-8B and 2,048 for Qwen3-32B.

value_zh.html: 未披露统一 episode 时程与每任务 rollout 组大小。Rollout batch size 对 Qwen3-8B 为 1,024，对 Qwen3-32B 为 2,048。

value.html: Zero-RL GRPO trains Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B for 48 steps. The public HTML does not expose the numerical learning rate; other optimizer, hardware, seed, and parallel scheduling details remain undisclosed.

value_zh.html: Zero-RL GRPO 训练 Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-32B 共 48 步。公开 HTML 未给出数值学习率；其他优化器、硬件、seed 与并行调度细节仍未披露。

value.html: Synthesis decomposes into multiple agent roles and RL uses rollout batches of 1,024 or 2,048. The paper reports token costs of about 546k per domain foundation and 93.2k per task, but does not disclose concurrency, wall time, worker count, retry distribution, or compute cost.

value_zh.html: 合成分解为多个智能体角色，RL 使用 1,024 或 2,048 的 rollout batches。论文报告每个领域基础约 546k、每个任务 93.2k 的 token 成本，但未披露并发、墙钟时间、worker 数、重试分布或计算成本。

value.html: All training tasks are generated from scratch across 16 domains. Evaluation uses 7 disjoint domains from tau2-Bench and VitaBench, whose tools and dialogue formats are stated to differ from training.

value_zh.html: 全部训练任务在 16 个领域上从零生成。评测使用来自 tau2-Bench 与 VitaBench 的 7 个不相交领域，其工具与对话格式被陈述为与训练不同。

value.html: The 2,560 generated tasks are a training universe rather than a public train/dev/test split. OOD evaluation is domain-disjoint: 3 tau2-Bench and 4 VitaBench domains. No generated-domain validation split or task-level holdout is disclosed.

value_zh.html: 2,560 个生成任务是训练全集而非公开 train/dev/test 划分。OOD 评测为领域不相交：3 个 tau2-Bench 与 4 个 VitaBench 领域。未披露生成领域验证划分或任务级留出。

value.html: The paper asserts training/evaluation domain and format separation. It does not release item-level mappings or a semantic overlap manifest against tau2-Bench, VitaBench, or synthesis-model training corpora.

value_zh.html: 论文主张训练/评测领域与格式分离。它未发布针对 tau2-Bench、VitaBench 或合成模型训练语料的条目级映射或语义重叠清单。

value.html: Domain names are disjoint and tool-description embeddings are visually separated, but no model pretraining-overlap, prompt/template deduplication, task-semantic overlap, or generator memorization audit is reported.

value_zh.html: 领域名称不相交且工具描述嵌入在视觉上分离，但未报告模型预训练重叠、提示/模板去重、任务语义重叠或生成器记忆化审计。

value.html: Procedural generation observes success, anticipated rejection, and unexpected failure, using the latter to drive debugging. GRPO requires mixed-reward rollout groups. The paper does not report candidate/rollout drop rates, whether all failed paths are retained, or any persistent public success/failure corpus.

value_zh.html: 程序化生成观察成功、预期拒绝与意外失败，并用后者驱动调试。GRPO 需要混合奖励 rollout 组。论文未报告候选/rollout 丢弃率、是否保留全部失败路径，或任何持久公开成功/失败语料。

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: Hard equality can reject equivalent timestamp, numeric, or serialization forms, while fuzzy semantic matching can admit incorrect free text.
Exempt fields may hide task-relevant side effects if column classification is wrong.
Final-state equality can miss invalid intermediate actions, unnecessary mutations, information disclosure, or paths that reach the right state for the wrong reason.
Generated procedural tests cover sampled cases and cannot prove correctness over the full action/state space.
A user simulator can alter task difficulty or reward-aligned behavior independently of the executable database verifier.
硬相等可能拒绝等价的时间戳、数值或序列化形式，而模糊语义匹配可能接受不正确的自由文本。
若列分类错误，豁免字段可能隐藏任务相关副作用。
终态相等可能漏掉无效中间动作、不必要变更、信息泄露，或以错误原因到达正确状态的路径。
生成的程序性测试覆盖抽样案例，无法在完整动作/状态空间上证明正确性。
用户模拟器可独立于可执行数据库验证器改变任务难度或奖励对齐行为。

value.html: Tasks, profiles, and database records are described as synthetic; no real-user data collection is reported. The paper does not document PII-pattern filters, memorization checks on generator outputs, provenance of realistic names/content, or a privacy review for released examples or future generated domains.

value_zh.html: 任务、画像与数据库记录被描述为合成；未报告真实用户数据收集。论文未记录 PII 模式过滤器、对生成器输出的记忆化检查、逼真名称/内容的出处，或对已发布示例或未来生成领域的隐私审查。

value.html: The arXiv manuscript is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. No verified license covers the generated environments, tasks, code, database states, rollouts, checkpoints, simulator outputs, or third-party benchmark assets.

value_zh.html: arXiv 手稿为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。无经验证的许可覆盖生成的环境、任务、代码、数据库状态、rollouts、checkpoints、模拟器输出或第三方基准资产。

value.html: Aggregate domain/task counts and the algorithmic chain are documented. Record-level IDs, generator prompts/outputs, model revisions, tests, debug attempts, discarded candidates, seeds, state diffs, rollout IDs, and reward records are not released.

value.html: Each task conceptually pairs an initial database state with code and a final-state criterion, which could support reset. value.html: ScaleEnv uses virtual sandboxes rather than real APIs, reducing accidental external harm. The Impact Statement warns that domain-agnostic generation could synthesize harmful or unethical environments and calls for oversight; no implemented malicious- domain classifier, capability restriction, prompt-injection defense, or sandbox containment audit is described.
